m_6f1b2d0ae87b.en: Generate text, URL, Wi-Fi, contact and email codes, or a batch of up to 50 text/URL codes. Scan a local image or explicitly start the camera.
m_6f1b2d0ae87b.zh-Hant: 可產生文字、網址、Wi-Fi、聯絡人和電子郵件二維碼，或一次產生最多 50 筆文字／網址二維碼。掃描本機圖片，或由你啟動相機。

m_ad267efd771d.en: Compare lines, words or characters, optionally ignoring case and whitespace. Navigate differences and export a .diff file.
m_ad267efd771d.zh-Hant: 依行、單詞或字元比較，可忽略大小寫和空白；可跳至各處差異並匯出 .diff 檔案。

m_94f354ba25a8.en: Wheel and draw use optional integer weights from 1 to 100; equal weights give equal chances. No-repeat draws use a pool. Groups ignore weights and differ by at most one member.
m_94f354ba25a8.zh-Hant: 轉盤與抽籤可設定 1–100 的整數權重，相同權重代表相同機率。不重複抽籤使用剩餘名單；分組不採用權重，各組人數最多相差一人。

m_3d061ceb0778.en: Public: 60 seconds and at least 95% accuracy. Practice: 15, 30, 60 or 120 seconds, with optional custom text. English uses WPM; Chinese uses CPM.
m_3d061ceb0778.zh-Hant: 公開測試：60 秒，準確率至少 95% 才可上榜。私人練習可選 15、30、60 或 120 秒，亦可自訂文字。英文以 WPM、中文以 CPM 計算。

m_7327c479e108.en: Screen, keyboard, mouse and multi-touch tests are temporary and started by you.
m_7327c479e108.zh-Hant: 螢幕、鍵盤、滑鼠與多點觸控測試均由你主動啟動，僅暫時執行。

m_4e34c372e25f.en: Passwords: 8–64 characters, default 20. Select at least one character category. Passphrases: 6–8 random words, default six.
m_4e34c372e25f.zh-Hant: 密碼可選 8–64 個字元，預設 20 個；至少選擇一種字元類別。單詞口令可選 6–8 個隨機單詞，預設六個。

m_47b6064b4dd9.en: Import CSV columns, flip a card and choose Known or Need practice. Known advances the review interval; Need practice schedules another review in ten minutes. Editing resets that card.
m_47b6064b4dd9.zh-Hant: 匯入時對應 CSV 欄位；翻面後選擇「已掌握」或「需練習」。已掌握會延長複習間隔，需練習會安排十分鐘後再複習；編輯會重設該卡。

m_efe36e38be2f.en: % means divide by 100. Use the calculation sheet for multiple lines and page-only named variables. Results identify approximations and errors.
m_efe36e38be2f.zh-Hant: % 代表除以 100。計算表支援多行及僅供目前頁面使用的命名變數；結果會標示近似值與錯誤。

m_91b291c8153d.en: Plans retain their chosen time zone across devices. JSON keeps the editable plan; ICS exports classes and deadlines to a calendar without connecting your account.
m_91b291c8153d.zh-Hant: 計畫在不同裝置保持固定時區。JSON 保留可編輯計畫；ICS 可將課程和期限匯入日曆，不會連接你的日曆帳號。

m_3a4308d0b4c1.zh-Hant: 目前沒有需要重試的失敗項目。

m_93c4fb60170f.en: Choose an image or PDF, then select the pages to recognize.
m_93c4fb60170f.zh-Hant: 請先選擇圖片或 PDF，再選擇要辨識的頁面。

m_6d690597c6ac.en: Audio editing is unavailable in this browser. Try Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
m_6d690597c6ac.zh-Hant: 此瀏覽器無法編輯音訊，請改用 Chrome、Edge 或 Firefox。

m_c547519e91a5.en: Tool files could not load. Save or download current work before reloading; source files must be selected again.
m_c547519e91a5.zh-Hant: 工具檔案載入失敗。重新載入前請先儲存或下載目前內容；來源檔案需要重新選擇。

m_94d23ea99c4a.zh-Hant: 設定已變更，請重新產生。
